caption: The image shows a drawing of a large, round, brown ceramic crock with two symmetrical, rounded handles on each side near the rim. The crock has a wide, open mouth and a slightly tapered base. The surface is primarily a medium brown color, suggesting clay or stoneware material, with some areas shaded darker to indicate curvature and shadow. Near the top of the crock, there is an inscription in capital letters reading "C. BOYNTON & CO." and below it the word "TROY." In the central area of the crock's body, there is a blue decorative design resembling a sprig or leaf, created with broad, visible brushstrokes. The handles are also accented with blue color. The background is plain beige with no additional objects or patterns. The overall composition centers the crock, displaying it in full, unobstructed view.
title: Crock
